verdict.rationale: Data export is a fair question for an LLM gateway that holds request logs, analytics and prompt-library content, but the evidence pack documents no export feature or open-format download of user data. The OpenAI-compatible drop-in API lowers switching cost, and the analytics dashboard and management API exist, but these are adjacent features, not a documented capability to export all data and leave.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
